# Buzzworks

A cozy idle honey tycoon you play in the browser. Tap the comb, build a hive empire, catch lucky bees and ticket bees, hatch a bee collection, equip hive cores, complete hive skins, earn crowns and open new worlds with their own twist.

English and French, light and dark themes, works on desktop and phone.

Plain JavaScript, no build step. The game lives in [`app/`](../app), and [`app/README.md`](../app/README.md) explains the gameplay, the Google cloud save setup and how to publish.
